title: KS-1076: should the lint gate stay in front of the Playwright suite in the same job, or be separated so the browser tests always run?
bluf: Ticket item 3 is marked 'a workflow-design call, Kam's; not taken here' (comment 90ba2f54, 2026-09-14). Measured then from live runs: the 'Playwright suite' job stopped at the static gate, then at the unit step; steps 8-10 (boot stack, browser, run API tests) were SKIPPED, so no browser test had run (comment 90ba2f54). Item 1 (jsdoc errors) is fixed: PR 896, 38a919d40 (same comment). Newer state, from the 2026-11-09 triage and not re-read by me: the job is still 'skipped' on develop's run 42593147283 after upstream failures. The failing unit cell named in the comment still exists in the local checkout a65ae7ed1 (systemTest/playwright/tests-unit/slot-required.test.ts line 49); whether it passes now is UNMEASURED. Client-human consequence: Peter and Stuart see a normal-looking red while no e2e coverage exists.

options.label: Split it: static and unit gates become their own jobs; the Playwright job always runs its browser tests
options.detail: A Secuura seat edits .github/workflows/pr-platform-suites.yml. A lint error can no longer silently remove e2e coverage. Cost: more CI minutes (UNMEASURED).

options.label: Keep the order, rename the job so the red names the real step
options.detail: Cheapest. Coverage still disappears whenever a harness lint or unit test fails.

options.label: Keep as is
options.detail: No change; coverage hole stays invisible by name.

default_action: After 48 h: c. Nothing changes (a .github workflow edit is Kam's to merge, card kam-merges); Wednesday re-asks Kam.
